risk_if_not_implemented: Without Provider Contingency Plan, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Domain Name Service (DNS) resolution is designed, implemented and managed to protect the security of name / address resolution.
compensating_control_1.justification: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution (NET-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Provider Contingency Plan (TPM-14.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Out-of-Band Channels
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize out-of-band channels for the electronic transmission of information and/or the physical shipment of system components or devices to authorized individuals.
compensating_control_2.justification: Out-of-Band Channels (NET-07) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Provider Contingency Plan (TPM-14.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
